ios.desc:
Gallivant is a fun new way to explore and rediscover the world around you. We have refined the fog-of-world concept to provide users with an awesome way of seeing where they have traveled and motivating destinations for future exploration! And the awesome part is that all this is done locally on your device! No need to send your location and travel information to anyone else!

Gallivant motivates you to continue exploring by tracking your exploration statistics and providing you with points of interest to discover on the map. The further away these points, the more points you get and the more tiles you unlock! Who knows what interesting new restaurants, parks, or museums you may find? Gallivant helps to keep your daily travels fresh and interesting. 

Rediscover the World
- Gallivant hides the world around you, so you can experience it in a fresh and interesting way. As you travel you will unlock the world tiles and see what you might have missed!

Explorer Levels
- As you explore you gain points which unlock famous explorer levels. Each explorer is a new testament to your travels! 

Gallivant Heat Map
- If you want to see where you spend the most time, you can activate the heat map, which will show you in bright colors your favorite destinations.

Destinations And Discoveries
- You can set arbitrary goals for yourself on the map with just a tap! Then gain explorer points for traveling to those destinations. As you explore, Gallivant will add new discoveries to your map, which you can visit to learn more about your area.
- When you visit a destination or a discovery you are rewarded with explorer points and the option to make a postcard of your visit. Save these and you can share them with your friends.

Dark and Light modes are implemented and controllable through the setting.

Join the fun and see just how fun the world around us is!

quotes.text: First serious app release I'm decently proud of. Track your travel and unlock the world around you. Includes a heatmap and automated travel goals using "discoveries" feature. Plus all data is totally on device!
